name: @huabeiyou/codex-companion
description: Codex Companion: native Codex workers and persistent topic conversations in Claude Code.

scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types && codex app-server generate-ts --out plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types
scripts.prototype:test: node --test tests/native-prototype.test.mjs && claude plugin test plugins/codex-native-prototype
scripts.bundle:validate: npm run bundle && claude plugin validate output/codex-local-marketplace --strict --json && claude plugin validate output/codex-local-marketplace/plugins/codex --strict --json
scripts.release:validate: npm run release:check && claude plugin validate . --strict --json && claude plugin validate release/plugins/codex --strict --json
scripts.release:test: claude plugin test release/plugins/codex && node scripts/native-prototype-acceptance.mjs --release --typecheck
